lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs are distributed across the visible dorsal and lateral surfaces of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side of the ridge line.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, dark, falcate caudal fin positioned in the immediate foreground, obscuring the posterior section of the peduncle due to the camera's posterior angle.
